disclosure: Precomputed model-style interpretations of checked-in demo evidence. These outputs never set scores, routes, blockers, approvals, or outcomes.

outputs.summary: Three independent public source families and synthetic consumer language point to a time-bounded confidence-under-pressure moment for Rexona. Commerce progression is positive but modest, and the operating record shows execution is only credible in the four cells that can serve demand.

themes.label: Consumers name the need, not the brand
Execution is narrower than the attention

counterHypothesis.claim: Seasonal heat plus one-off match attention may explain the movement without any brand-specific demand shift; the commerce record is too weak to separate the two.

outputs.summary: Search language persists well beyond a single event window and synthetic consumer routines describe scalp-first behaviour, which supports a durable shift rather than a moment. Claim substantiation and product readiness remain the binding constraints.

counterHypothesis.claim: Interest may stay informational and never convert into a distinct paid hair-care routine, leaving the category with attention but no new demand.

outputs.summary: Visible attention is concentrated in a single creator family and is not accompanied by category search or commerce progression, so the spike does not currently describe category demand.

themes.label: One source family carries the spike

counterHypothesis.claim: Paid seeding, creator novelty, or entertainment value explains the spike better than any deodorant category demand shift.

outputs.summary: The first-monsoon window is corroborated by weather, search, social and invented aggregate commerce evidence. Prepared inventory, cleared creator rights and existing stain-removal claim support make this a growth activation ready for human approval.

counterHypothesis.claim: Rain and stain-removal search can rise together without the activation changing demand; preparedness establishes permission to act, not incremental impact.

missingEvidence: Post-activation descriptive response against the recent baseline

outputs.summary: An ingredient claim about the category is spreading across three independent source families, and the correcting facts are already substantiated and approved. The evidence describes a reputational exposure with a short window, not a demand opportunity.

counterHypothesis.claim: Responding may raise the claim's reach further than ignoring it would, so speed of response and size of response are separate questions that this evidence cannot settle together.

missingEvidence: Reach of the claim among category buyers specifically
Response-versus-silence outcome from a comparable prior episode

outputs.summary: A dated heat-wave advisory, category search acceleration and rising q-commerce units agree that demand is real and time-bound. The operating record disagrees about where it can be served: national days-cover cannot support the demand a national campaign would create.

counterHypothesis.claim: Frozen dessert rises with temperature every year, so the spike may be ordinary seasonality that any campaign would have been credited with regardless.

missingEvidence: Cell-level service level under a campaign load

outputs.summary: Monsoon skin-dullness interest is corroborated across search, news and consumer language, and the moment sits inside more than one brand's territory. The campaign record shows an overlapping campaign already in market, which makes ownership rather than evidence the open question.

counterHypothesis.claim: Monsoon dullness language may describe a weather complaint rather than a purchase intent, in which case the moment is conversational and no brand needs to own it.

missingEvidence: Purchase intent behind the dullness language
Incremental effect of the overlapping campaign already running

outputs.summary: Cleanser pH scrutiny persists across three months and two independent source families. A 21 January 2021 appeal order permitted parts of the comparison with restrictions; a 16 June 2022 interim decision later restrained the impugned campaign pending the suit. Neither is presented as a final merits judgment, so the action is claims capability-building.

counterHypothesis.claim: Sustained pH interest may be informational curiosity driven by coverage rather than a change in what people buy, in which case entering the conversation carries the claims risk without the demand.

missingEvidence: Purchase behaviour among people using pH language
Approved substantiation for any comparative gentleness claim

outputs.summary: One hack format is spreading very fast, but category search is flat over the same seven days, basket attach has not moved, and most reach is attributable to a single platform surface. The evidence describes visibility rather than demand.

counterHypothesis.claim: Recommendation-driven reach can precede category search by several days, so this may be an early real signal observed too soon rather than an empty one.

missingEvidence: The same measures seven days later
